label: Finite actual esse pair checks can leave the MAXIME_ENS_1 universal giver unidentified
paraphrase: On the same countably infinite roster of actual bearers, each choice of giver defines a ranked profile with well-founded actual esse causation and rooted closed collections. At the sole respect, esse, every actual cause is strictly more in esse than its recipient. The selected giver is the unique maximal bearer, directly gives every other bearer its esse, and is every bearer's unique supplierless ancestor. Each bearer has a finite certificate using complete incoming lists for that ancestor. For every finite set of ordered pairs on the baseline profile, a completion with a different giver agrees on every tested actual esse edge and non-edge. The completion's giver appears in neither projection of the tested pairs and directly gives the baseline giver its esse. The baseline giver therefore ceases to be its own supplierless ancestor in that completion.
